rows.definition: internal/modver.AppendGuarded appends already-rendered fak-module-versions/1 JSONL to the module-versions ledger while holding an exclusive internal/flock advisory lock on <ledger>.lock, so two agents stamping the shared multi-session trunk cannot interleave a torn or duplicated row (#2473).
rows.distinction: It is a file-level concurrency serialiser guarding one ledger O_APPEND write — it admits nothing and evaluates no predicate; contrast the validation/policy guard-gates (CheckExternalizeGate, gateVerbTierTree, the guard stop hook) that gate a turn, commit, or rotation on a check.
